papers.title_en: Standards-Guided and Dependency-Aware Code-Level Documentation Generation
papers.authors: Tingxu Han, Wei Song, Ziming Li, Yuchen Chen, Weisong Sun, Zhenpeng Chen, Chunrong Fang, Zhenyu Chen, Yang Liu
papers.evidence: 标准引导且依赖感知的自动化代码文档生成
papers.tldr: 代码级文档生成常被视为无约束文本生成，缺少显式质量标准、依赖长上下文且评估难复现。CODEDOC把该任务重构为标准引导的软件工程问题，利用静态调用图与AST构建依赖感知结构化提示，并结合LLM评审反馈按细粒度准则优化文档。在十个开源Python仓库上，其标准对齐评估优于RepoAgent和长上下文基线，相对提升11.6%-17.0%与21.4%-29.6%，且token消耗约低一个数量级。表明标准引导与依赖感知有效。
papers.abstract_en: Automatically generating high-quality documentation for software repositories remains challenging: existing approaches largely treat documentation as unconstrained text generation, lacking explicit quality specifications, depending heavily on long-context prompts over raw code, and offering limited support for reproducible evaluation. We argue that code-level documentation generation should instead be a standards-guided software engineering task, in which documentation is generated and assessed against explicit, reusable quality requirements derived from authoritative standards. We define code documentation as natural-language descriptions of repository functions and classes, organized by source-code path. We present CODEDOC, a standards-guided and dependency-aware framework that identifies dependencies between code entities via static call-graph and AST analysis and constructs dependency-aware structured prompts combining local code context, repository paths, and documentation criteria drawn from authoritative standards and style guides. We further introduce an interactive LLM-as-a-judge protocol that supplies criterion-aligned feedback to refine generated documentation along fine-grained dimensions from formal and practice-oriented standards. Experiments on ten open-source Python repositories show that CODEDOC produces higher-quality documentation than RepoAgent and a long-context baseline under standards-aligned evaluation, with relative improvements of 11.6%-17.0% and 21.4%-29.6%, respectively, while consuming roughly an order of magnitude fewer tokens per documentation entity than the long-context baseline. A human study confirms substantial alignment between LLM-based and human judgments (Spearman's rho = 0.72), and the relative findings hold across different judge LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/ControllableModel/CodeDoc.

papers.title_en: Enhancing Bug-Exposing Test Generation via Step-Level Credit Assignment and Self-Distillation from Valuable Failures
papers.authors: Wenjie Gan, Zhaoxi Zhang, Jiahui Liang, Weikang Li, Wanyuan Wang, Li Zhang, Jian Dong
papers.evidence: 基于大模型的自动化缺陷暴露测试生成
papers.tldr: 大模型生成的代码常含细微缺陷，自动修复需要能暴露错误并给出正确期望输出的测试。现有RL测试生成对所有推理步骤施加相同结果奖励，且未充分利用“触发缺陷但输出错误”的轨迹。SCALF将步骤级信用分配与有价值失败轨迹的自蒸馏结合，为各推理阶段提供独立学习信号。三个基准上，其联合成功率、输出正确率和缺陷触发率最高分别提升2.97、5.26和3.53个百分点。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models have shown strong code generation capabilities, yet their outputs often contain subtle bugs. Automatically repairing such code requires informative tests: inputs that expose faulty behavior, paired with correct expected outputs. Recent RL-based test generation methods apply the same outcome reward to all reasoning steps, which can discourage useful reasoning and reinforce flawed steps. They also fail to effectively learn from trajectories that find bug-triggering inputs but predict incorrect outputs, leaving their verified bug-triggering progress insufficiently exploited. To address these limitations, we propose SCALF, a process-supervised RL approach that combines Step-level Credit Assignment with targeted Learning from valuable Failed trajectories. SCALF derives step-specific advantages from process rewards, allowing each reasoning stage to receive its own learning signal. It further routes trajectories that expose bugs but predict incorrect outputs to on-policy self-distillation, using execution feedback to learn from their valuable bug-triggering progress. Across three benchmarks, SCALF outperforms strong prompting and post-training baselines by up to 2.97, 5.26, and 3.53 percentage points in joint success rate, output correctness rate, and bug-triggering rate, respectively. Our code and datasets are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SCALF-F4D1.

papers.title_en: GenXR-Bench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Interactive XR Development
papers.authors: William Huang, David Li, Xiang 'Anthony' Chen, Xun Qian, Nels Numan, Zhongyi Zhou, Hyunsung Cho, Salman Muin Kayser Chishti, Ding Xia, Xincheng Huang, Jiahao Ren, Faraz Faruqi, Tianyu Xu, Yang Zhang, David Kim, Ruofei Du
papers.evidence: 面向XR应用开发的编码智能体评测基准
papers.tldr: 针对编码智能体在交互式XR开发中的评测空白，本文提出首个端到端基准GenXR-Bench。它含112个专家任务，覆盖24项功能实现、21个缺陷修复和67个应用生成，并用脚本化与自适应交互、程序化与视觉断言评测运行时行为。测试套件对124个候选应用的盲评一致率达96.5%；10个模型中最强配置总体Pass@1仅50.9%。该基准揭示了异步传感器生命周期、物理grounding与具身交互语义等常见失败，为空间计算智能体评测提供可复现平台。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are rapidly advancing from single-file generation to long-horizon repository-scale engineering, yet the evaluation of their capabilities to author interactive extended reality (XR) applications remains an open challenge. Unlike traditional software, XR applications operate within dynamic 3D physical environments where runtime robustness depends jointly on continuous user motion, spatial input, and environmental sensing. We introduce GenXR-Bench, the first benchmark for the end-to-end evaluation of coding agents in XR software development. GenXR-Bench contains 112 expert-authored tasks spanning 24 feature implementations, 21 bug repairs, and 67 application generation tasks. Held-out tests combine scripted and adaptive interactions with programmatic and visual assertions to evaluate core functionality and runtime behavior. GenXR-Bench's testing suite achieves 96.5% accuracy against blinded expert judgments of 124 candidate applications executed on consumer XR hardware. Evaluating 10 models on GenXR-Bench, we find that the strongest configuration achieves only 50.9% overall Pass@1. Failure analysis identifies recurring misunderstandings in asynchronous sensor lifecycles, physical grounding, and embodied interaction semantics. GenXR-Bench establishes a reproducible testbed for evaluating coding agents in the interactive and physically situated conditions of spatial computing.

papers.title_en: UserSWE: Evaluating Coding Agents in Multi-Turn Conversations with Dynamic Users
papers.authors: Zhan-Yu Wu, Ji Luo, Alyssa Wu, Junjielong Xu, Richeng Xuan, Zhichao Hu, Chongming Gao, Xinting Hu
papers.evidence: 评估编码智能体在多轮对话中修复仓库缺陷的基准
papers.tldr: 现有编码智能体基准多把完整问题一次性给出，难以评估真实多轮修复缺陷的交互能力，并可能误判补丁。UserSWE 将仓库历史与单轮基准转化为多轮任务，用信息池约束用户透露内容、用经 20,859 次开发会话校准的人格链控制表达，并在每轮后运行测试。它由不同模型家族的双智能体依据测试结果撰写并把关裁决。在 42 个仓库的 72 个任务上评测 11 个智能体，排名随交互预算变化，说明单轮成绩不足以刻画交互式编码能力。
papers.abstract_en: As coding agents become more capable, developers increasingly use them to fix bugs through multi-turn interactions. Existing benchmarks do not adequately cover this scenario. Most present a complete issue report in a single turn without interaction. Their evaluation can produce both false positives and false negatives, accepting incorrect patches or rejecting correct ones. We introduce UserSWE for evaluating coding agents' ability to fix repository-level bugs through multi-turn interactions with dynamic users and execution-grounded verdicts at every turn. Its construction pipeline turns repository history and existing single-turn benchmarks into multi-turn tasks. At each turn, information pools constrain what the simulated user can reveal, while a persona chain sampled from a transition model calibrated on 20,859 development sessions governs how it speaks. Tests run after every turn, and a pair of agents from different model families writes and gates each verdict, using test results as primary evidence and model judgment only for aspects the tests cannot resolve. We evaluate eleven agents on 72 tasks from 42 repositories and find that agent rankings change with the interaction budget. Claude Fable 5.1 resolves the most tasks in one turn, GPT-6-Astra resolves the most by the eighth turn, and Claude Opus 5 leads at most intermediate budgets. These results indicate that single-turn performance is insufficient to characterize interactive coding ability.

papers.title_en: PAUSE: Search-Free Steering of Coding Agents Before Their First Source-Code Edit
papers.authors: Viral Patel, Boyin Tan, Jason Xue, Youcheng Sun
papers.evidence: 在首次改代码前对编码智能体进行单次规划干预
papers.tldr: 编码智能体常耗费大量探索与测试仍产出失败补丁，现有在线引导频繁审查且难以判断方向正确性。PAUSE在智能体首次修改源码前拦截请求，由独立Planner读取任务与编辑前轨迹生成一次修复计划，Executor保留上下文与工作区继续执行。在SWE-bench Verified与Multilingual上，在线引导提升解决率16.8%和14.7%，离线恢复35.4%的合格失败任务。该方法无需学习监控器、检查点搜索或额外模型调用，以低规划成本实现搜索无关的单次干预。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents can invest substantial effort in repository exploration and testing yet still produce unsuccessful patches. Existing online steering methods review trajectories periodically or invoke an advisor when a monitor detects behavioral problems; frequent reviews are costly, and the absence of anomalous behavior does not mean that an agent is on the right track. We propose PAUSE, a framework for steering coding agents with a single planning intervention. Agents reach their first source-code edit at a median of 60% of trajectory progress, after exploration, bug reproduction, and testing. PAUSE intercepts this edit request before it executes, which requires no learned monitor, no search over checkpoints, and no extra model call (search-free). A separate Planner reads the task and the pre-edit transcript and writes one repair plan; the same agent, the Executor, resumes with this plan, keeping its context and workspace. PAUSE applies online, during a live run, and offline, from a recorded trajectory prefix. We evaluate PAUSE on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Multilingual with two Executors and three agent harnesses. With Qwen3-coder as Executor and GPT-5.6 Sol as Planner, online steering improves resolution by 16.8% on Verified in OpenHands and by 14.7% on Multilingual in SWE-agent. In SWE-agent, PAUSE outperforms LivePlan, a rule-triggered advisor, by 3.2% on Verified and 3.7% on Multilingual at similar Planner cost, and is comparable to SICA's periodic overseer at about 11-15% of its Planner cost. Offline, PAUSE recovers 35.4% of eligible failed Verified tasks, and resuming from the recorded prefix uses 33-41% fewer Executor tokens than restarting.

papers.title_en: Code Comprehensor: Hierarchical Documentation and Cross-Modal Retrieval for Large Repositories
papers.authors: Sujoy Roychowdhury, Joseph H. R. Isaac, Jiangning Gao, Martin Klitte, Diarmuid Corcoran
papers.evidence: 面向大型仓库的LLM分层文档生成
papers.tldr: 大型复杂代码库理解困难，且将相关代码上下文有效提供给LLM仍具挑战。Code Comprehensor结合调用图CodeGraph、分层文档生成CodeScribe和CLIP式双编码器CodeContrast，学习对齐的文本-代码嵌入，实现语义精确的代码邻域检索，并通过MCP编排器为LLM提供证据。在OpenCV和500万行私有库上，CodeScribe监督提升文本到代码检索准确率，分层文档与合成问题等更丰富文本监督持续增益。RAGAS评测显示输出忠实度超过90%。
papers.abstract_en: Understanding large, complex, and rapidly evolving code bases remains a core challenge for software engineering at scale, hindering onboarding, maintenance, refactoring, and impact analysis. Providing this information to a Large-Language Model (LLM) is another hurdle, as the LLM must understand not only the required code method but also its associated methods in the grand scheme of the repository. We propose Code Comprehensor, a hybrid retrieval-reasoning framework combining (i) CodeGraph, a code dependency callgraph, (ii) CodeScribe, which uses code-aware LLMs to generate hierarchical documentation across repository call graphs, and (iii) CodeContrast, a CLIP-style dual-encoder model trained on CodeScribe output to learn aligned text-code embeddings. CodeContrast enables fast, semantically precise retrieval of relevant code-context neighborhoods, which serve as grounded evidence for an MCP-based LLM orchestrator answering domain-specific queries. Evaluation on OpenCV and a proprietary 5M-LOC repository shows that CodeScribe-derived supervision significantly improves cross-modal retrieval in text-to-code accuracy over baseline approaches. Richer textual supervision (hierarchical documentation, parent/sibling context, and LLM-generated synthetic questions) consistently enhances performance across both repositories. LLM-as-a-judge evaluation using the popular RAGAS of the Code Comprehensor output yields above 90% faithfulness scores.

papers.title_en: SWE-DIVE: Multi-Turn Coding Agent Evaluation with Dynamic User Simulation
papers.authors: Lorenz Brehme, Benjamin Steenhoek, Ruth Breu
papers.evidence: 面向编码智能体的动态多轮评测框架与用户模拟
papers.tldr: 现有编码智能体多依赖一次性且表述良好的提示，SWE-bench等用GitHub issue评估，难以反映真实多轮交互中用户逐步追加需求的情形。作者提出SWE-DIVE动态交互式评估框架，引入可模拟不同行为模式的用户模拟器，并用对话验证器检查输出是否满足初始要求、引导智能体完成任务。框架嵌入Harbor环境，统一编排编码智能体、用户模拟器与对话验证器，并执行测试环境判定任务是否解决。该工作为多轮编码智能体评测提供动态基准思路，源码已公开。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are typically evaluated using one-shot, well-formulated prompts. Benchmarks such as SWE-bench use existing GitHub issues as input for a coding agent and evaluate whether the agent successfully solves the task. However, in real-world use cases, prompts are often not as well-formulated or structured as existing GitHub issues. Additionally, a coding agent session is not limited to a single prompt; it typically involves a multi-turn interaction in which the user iteratively adds new tasks and requirements that the agent must fulfill.   To benchmark these abilities, we developed SWE-DIVE, a dynamic, interactive validation and evaluation framework for benchmarking coding agents in a multi-turn environment. To achieve this, we introduce a user simulator that can simulate different behavioral patterns and communicate with the coding agent. We also introduce a conversation validator that evaluates the user simulator's outputs to determine whether they fulfill the initial requirements and guide the agent toward successfully solving the task. The entire framework is embedded in a Harbor environment, which orchestrates the coding agent, user simulator, and conversation validator, and executes the test environment to determine whether the agent successfully solves the task. Our results and source code are available in our GitHub repository (https://github.com/lorenzbrehme/swe-dive_usersim).

papers.title_en: Adaptive Skill Granularity for Coding Agents: Runtime Routing and Macro-to-Micro Recovery
papers.authors: Dingxuan Zhang, Yanhui Jiang, Jun Wang, Hefeng Zhou
papers.evidence: 编码智能体技能粒度的运行期路由与宏微回退
papers.tldr: 可复用技能让LLM智能体模块化执行任务，但编码智能体在运行时仍面临选择原子工具调用、宏技能或混合执行的问题。本文提出自适应技能粒度框架，将技能粒度视为受任务结构、执行状态和宏技能失败影响的动作抽象策略，并结合特征控制器与有限状态恢复执行器。实验显示固定宏执行适用时高效但失配时脆弱，运行时路由与显式宏到微恢复可提升鲁棒性并恢复受控宏失败。该工作表明编码智能体技能库不仅是可检索资源，也是可控、可验证、可恢复的执行抽象。
papers.abstract_en: Reusable skills allow large language model agents to package task-specific procedures, tool affordances, and execution guidance into modular units. Prior work has largely studied how agents retrieve, compose, or synthesize skills before execution. In coding agents, however, execution poses an additional runtime control problem: the same task may be solved through primitive tool calls, macro skills, or hybrid execution that starts with a macro and falls back to micro-level recovery. We introduce Adaptive Skill Granularity, a framework that treats skill granularity as an action-abstraction policy conditioned on task structure, execution state, and macro-skill failures. The system combines a feature-based granularity controller and a finite-state recovery executor. We evaluate the framework with a deterministic coding-agent protocol using verifier-defined success, total cost, and process metrics such as macro adoption, failure recovery, route match, and transition correctness. Results show that fixed macro execution is efficient when applicable but brittle under mismatch, while runtime routing and explicit macro-to-micro recovery improve robustness and recover controlled macro failures that fixed-granularity execution leaves unresolved. Our findings suggest that skill libraries for coding agents should be treated not only as retrievable resources, but also as controllable, verifiable, and recoverable execution abstractions.

papers.title_en: SWE-Clar: Can Coding Agents Clarify Incomplete Client Requirements and Deliver Greenfield Software?
papers.authors: Jialei Li, Dingxian Wang, Xiaoyan Zhao, Yimeng Bai, Xuanyi Zhu, Yang Zhang, Chao Yin, Wentao Shi, Ganesh Prabhu, Karthik Gomadam Rajagopal, Brett Levert, Darvin Yi, Andrew Rabinovich, Zhao Chen
papers.evidence: 编程智能体澄清需求并交付软件
papers.tldr: 自由职业场景中的绿地软件开发常面对不完整需求，编码智能体需先澄清再实现。SWE-Clar基于100个真实Upwork高价值任务构建，采用多轮客户代理交互，并将代码实现与需求理解评测隔离运行。实验显示九个前沿模型中最佳GPT-6 Astra任务通过率仅67%，表明独立交付仍具挑战。该基准凸显需求澄清与理解评估对智能体落地的重要性。
papers.abstract_en: Greenfield software development in freelance settings requires coding agents to turn incomplete client requests into working software. This makes requirement clarification essential, yet clients may be unable to provide continuous feedback over long development cycles, and receiving their answers does not guarantee correct understanding of complex requirements. These challenges motivate two benchmark design choices: clarification precedes code implementation, and its effectiveness is assessed through explicit tests of requirement understanding. Guided by these choices, we introduce SWE-Clar, a benchmark grounded in real, high-value client commissions to evaluate requirement clarification and code implementation in this setting. It comprises 100 tasks based on real software development jobs on Upwork, each with at least US\$4,000 in total payments. Each task begins with multi-round interaction between a coding agent and a client agent, followed by separate runs for code implementation with acceptance testing and clarification assessment. For the latter, we construct 512 questions paired with reference answers from real client-freelancer interactions, covering both explicitly stated requirements and those inferred from the conversational context. Both runs begin from the same clarification context but remain isolated, preventing assessment questions from guiding code implementation. Experiments with nine frontier models show that even GPT-6 Astra, which has the highest observed implementation score, achieves a task pass rate of only 67%, underscoring the challenge of independent software delivery in this setting. The dataset and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/upwork/SWE-Clar.

papers.title_en: Pairing Matters: Performance, Failures, and Efficiency in Lightweight Coding Agents
papers.authors: Lu Zhao, Christopher M. Poskitt, David Lo
papers.evidence: 轻量级自托管编码智能体的框架与模型配对研究
papers.tldr: 自托管轻量编码代理需将模型与代理框架配对，但现有榜单多固定配置，缺少受控比较。作者对6个开源框架与3个轻量模型做全因子评测，覆盖100个SWE-bench Verified任务，共1800次评分运行。同一模型跨框架解决率最高差44个百分点，框架排名随模型变化；失败模式与每解决任务token消耗也强烈依赖配对，效率差距超20倍。
papers.abstract_en: Self-hosting coding agents is often necessary for software-engineering teams that must keep proprietary code and development traces within controlled infrastructure. Lightweight, open-weight models make such deployment more feasible by reducing hardware requirements, while strong results on repository-level benchmarks demonstrate their potential for demanding coding tasks. Deploying these models as coding agents requires pairing them with an agent harness, making their joint performance a key deployment consideration. Yet existing leaderboards primarily report fixed harness-model configurations rather than controlled comparisons across alternative pairings. To address this gap, we investigate harness-model interactions through a controlled full-factorial evaluation of six open-source harnesses and three lightweight coding models across 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks, producing 1,800 graded runs under common serving, metering, and grading conditions. For the same model, resolution rates differ by up to 44 percentage points across harnesses, while harness rankings change across models. We apply an evidence-based failure taxonomy to 1,100 unsuccessful runs and find substantial differences in failure patterns across harness-model pairings. A model's dominant failure modes under one harness need not dominate under another. Efficiency is similarly dependent on the pairing: even among model-directed loop harnesses, charged tokens per resolved task vary by more than 20-fold. These findings make harness-model selection a central deployment decision for lightweight coding agents. Strong performance with one harness or model does not guarantee similar results with another. We translate these findings into practitioner guidance for pairing selection, token-efficiency assessment, and trajectory-informed harness engineering, and release the complete experimental records and analysis artifacts.

papers.title_en: SWE-Shift: Evaluating Coding Agents in Evolving Workspaces
papers.authors: Victor Shea-Jay Huang, Rongqing Li, Zhangyue Yin, Kelong Mao, Yaqi Zhao, Xinyuan Wang, Yao Yin, Lirui Luo, Renrui Zhang, Hongsheng Li
papers.evidence: 评估编码智能体在执行中工作区变化下的基准
papers.tldr: 现有仓库级编码基准通常假定任务与环境在执行中不变，但真实开发中代码、依赖、运行时状态和需求会中途变化。SWE-Shift 从同一保存历史与工作区构造 Clean 与匹配 Shifted 续作，在 12 类变化、9 个干预位置共 120 个场景中评估代理。17 个系统在 Shifted 下成功率均低于 Clean，GPT-6 Astra 从 67.35% 降至 24.79%，配对成功率 20.34%。结果表明，未变任务成功并不等于能保留有效工作、恢复状态或刷新证据。
papers.abstract_en: Repository-level coding benchmarks largely assume that tasks and environments remain unchanged throughout execution. In software development, code, dependencies, runtime state, and requirements can change while an agent is still working. We introduce SWE-Shift, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents under such mid-execution changes. From the same saved history and workspace, a Clean continuation proceeds without intervention, while a matched Shifted continuation receives a task-relevant update. Success requires completing the current task, preserving still-valid work, and satisfying the applicable state and evidence checks. The benchmark contains 120 scenarios across 12 change families, each evaluated at nine scheduled intervention positions. We evaluate 17 coding-agent systems, all of which have lower Shifted than Clean success. GPT-6 Astra drops from 67.35% to 24.79%, with 20.34% paired success. Tool/session changes and stale evidence yield zero paired success across all systems. Late-position paired success is lower for some systems and higher for others. These results show that success on the unchanged task can coexist with failures to preserve work, recover state, or refresh evidence after an update.

papers.title_en: From Faulty Claims to Incorrect Patches: An Empirical Study of Task-Grounded Reasoning in Coding Agents
papers.authors: You Wang, Jinjun Huang, Zhonghao Jiang, Jialun Cao, Jiachi Chen, Zhongxin Liu
papers.evidence: LLM编程智能体推理失败的实证研究
papers.tldr: LLM编码智能体常因对代码、需求或修复方案的错误理解而失败，已有轨迹研究多关注任务无关行为模式。本文提出任务锚定推理研究，从400条SWE-bench Pro轨迹的思维链中抽取原子主张，用LLM智能体核验并做修正回放。结果显示任务相关主张仅占18.5% token，却每条轨迹约191条，至少9.6%有误；三分之二错误补丁可追溯到错误主张，修正后89.0%能修复关联缺陷。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based coding agents increasingly resolve real-world software engineering tasks, yet still fail on many of them. Prior trajectory studies characterize these failures through task-agnostic patterns of agent behavior, such as repeated actions. However, an agent may follow a sound workflow yet act on a faulty understanding of the existing code, the task requirements, or a candidate fix. Reasoning models, which power most state-of-the-art coding agents, reveal this understanding in their native chain-of-thought (CoT), whose claims about the task can be checked against the facts. Yet it remains unclear how many such checkable claims the CoT contains, how many are faulty, and whether faulty claims actually cause incorrect patches. We present the first empirical study of such claims, which we term task-grounded reasoning, analyzing 400 trajectories of four open-weight reasoning models on SWE-bench Pro. We extract atomic claims from the CoT with an LLM, assess them against evidence gathered by an LLM agent, and manually trace the defects of incorrect patches back to faulty claims, confirming each link with a claim-corrected replay. Task-grounded reasoning covers only 18.5% of the CoT tokens, yet yields 191 atomic claims per trajectory, at least 9.6% of which are faulty. Faulty claims also occur in 96.7% of the resolved trajectories, so their mere presence is a weak signal of failure. Yet two thirds of the 188 incorrect patches trace back to faulty claims. Correcting such a claim makes the agent fix the linked defect in 89.0% of the cases, and correcting all such claims resolves 11.7% of the failed tasks. Our findings show that the CoT carries task-specific signals for diagnosing and repairing agent failures, but exploiting them requires pinpointing the few faulty claims that actually cause patch defects.

papers.title_en: StateMirror: Pre-Execution Detection of Hallucinated Tool Calls in Coding Agents
papers.authors: Shiwen Shan, Yintong Huo, Zhiying Wu, Yuxin Su
papers.evidence: 在LLM编码智能体中执行前检测幻觉工具调用
papers.tldr: 编码智能体常产生访问不存在路径、缺失包等幻觉工具调用，事后恢复平均需3步和22.4K token。StateMirror在harness边界拦截动作，以AST和命令分析抽取状态谓词，并在执行前对实时仓库做确定性校验。在2,508个动作上取得0.940精确率和0.817 F1，F1超最强LLM裁判35.3%，延迟从17.73秒降至1.50毫秒且零token。预执行反馈可纠正超95%幻觉调用，实测降低执行时间15.8%和token 11.8%。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based coding agents may propose invalid actions that are not applicable in the execution environment, such as accessing non-existent paths or missing packages. We term this mismatch hallucinated tool use. A preliminary study of 4,398 agent trajectories reveals that these hallucinations are pervasive and costly, requiring a median of 3 additional interaction steps and 22.4K tokens to recover. Existing frameworks rely on reactive, post-execution feedback, wasting runtime resources. Nevertheless, since an agent's execution environment is grounded in concrete codebase and harness components, many action prerequisites can be extracted and validated prior to execution. To this end, we introduce StateMirror, a lightweight pre-execution detector. StateMirror intercepts actions at the harness boundary, extracts state predicates via AST and command analysis, and deterministically validates them against the live repository. By pinpointing exact environment mismatches before execution, StateMirror preempts invalid actions and subsequent recovery cycles. Evaluation on 2,508 actions shows StateMirror achieves 0.940 precision and 0.817 F1 in detecting such hallucinations, surpassing the strongest LLM judge by 35.3% in F1 while reducing median detection latency from 17.73 s to 1.50 ms with zero token consumption. For practical mitigation, StateMirror's pre-execution feedback enables agents to rectify over 95% of hallucinated tool calls. During live mitigation on 79 tasks, StateMirror reduces agent execution time by 15.8% and token consumption by 11.8% while maintaining task resolution.

papers.title_en: Secure and Functional Code Generation with Self-Evaluation
papers.authors: Md Afif Al Mamun, Gias Uddin
papers.evidence: 基于大模型与CWE知识检索的安全代码生成
papers.tldr: LLM生成的代码常功能正确但不安全，而安全微调成本高、安全提示又可能牺牲功能。SecGent在推理阶段从CWE数据库检索与任务相关的弱点文本作为安全指导，不依赖易受攻击或已修复的代码样例，并用功能测试与安全测试的反馈引导修复。在CWEval上，五个模型全部取得最高的功能-安全联合成功率，开源模型FS@1较RAG平均提升15.5%，Sonnet达92.1%。这表明任务对齐的弱点知识与双目标反馈能在不损失功能的前提下有效提升代码安全性。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate functionally correct code that remains insecure. Security-focused fine-tuning can be expensive and is not always available, motivating inference-time approaches. Security-oriented prompting and retrieval can reduce vulnerabilities, but may also remove required behavior or apply defenses incompatible with the task. The challenge is to identify relevant security knowledge and use it to improve security without sacrificing functionality. We present SecGent, an inference-time framework that retrieves weakness context from the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) database and applies it to secure code generation. By connecting task specifications to relevant textual CWE records, SecGent provides task-specific security guidance without relying on retrieved vulnerable or patched code examples. Complementary functional and security tests check the resulting implementation, and their execution feedback guides repairs toward satisfying both objectives. We evaluate SecGent with four open-source LLMs and Claude Sonnet 5.5 across five programming languages on the CWEval benchmark. It achieves the highest joint functional--security success against four inference-time baselines for all five models. Across the open-weight models, mean functional-security@1 (FS@1) improves by 15.5% over RAG, with gains in both functionality and security, and by 19.8% over the strongest prompt optimizer compiled for each model. On Sonnet, FS@1 reaches 92.1%, outperforming the strongest baseline AutoGen by 4.8%. In a separate comparison, SecGent outperforms Claude Code with security-focused prompting by over 6% in FS@1. Feedback-guided repair further improves FS@1 by up to 6.7% over generation without feedback, primarily by recovering functionality while checking security.

papers.title_en: Software Engineering LLMs: Why We Need Them and How Software Engineering Helps Build Them
papers.authors: Amir M. Ebrahimi, Mohammed Mehedi Hasan, Seyed Shayan Daneshvar, Jiahuei Lin, Gopi Krishnan Rajbahadur, Ahmed E. Hassan
papers.evidence: 用软件工程知识训练编码大模型
papers.tldr: 面向十万级开发者的92B代码大模型显示，软件工程知识可指导能力选择、可验证数据构建与评估。作者以仓库级重构为切入点，构建RefactorForge流水线，融合重构知识、工程工具与验证技术生成训练任务。仅用约占前序语料0.46%的增量监督微调，便在RefactorBench提升18个百分点，并在多个SWE基准和代理框架上取得增益。该工业案例总结了能力导向训练经验，并提出将SE知识融入模型训练与维护的研究议程。
papers.abstract_en: Software engineering (SE) expertise can shape how coding large language models (LLMs) are trained and which engineering capabilities they acquire. We examine this role through an industrial case study of capability-focused training for a 92B-parameter coding LLM serving more than 100,000 developers. We demonstrate how established SE knowledge can guide the selection of engineering capabilities, the construction of verifiable training data, and the evaluation of model improvements. To target repository-level refactoring, we developed RefactorForge, a pipeline that combines refactoring knowledge, established SE tools, and verification techniques to construct training data. Across 306 Python repositories, RefactorForge generated 5,704 executable tasks and retained 4,572 verified teacher trajectories totaling 72.51 million tokens. Incremental supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories, accounting for 0.46% of the preceding coding mixture's tokens, improved RefactorBench performance by 18.00 percentage points and SWE-Bench ProMax performance by 7.06 points. Under OpenCode, these improvements extended to SWE issue resolution, with gains of 4.97 points on SWE-Bench Verified and 1.23 points on SWE-Bench Pro. Improvements also persisted across other coding-agent harnesses, while greenfield repository generation showed mixed results. We report lessons from constructing capability-focused training data and evaluating its effects across engineering workloads. Building on this industrial experience, we propose a research agenda for expanding SE's role in transforming coding LLMs into SE LLMs: incorporating SE knowledge into model training, applying engineering methods to model development and maintenance, and systematically defining the engineering capabilities these models should acquire.

papers.title_en: How Do Small Coding Agents Use Code Graphs and Embeddings?
papers.authors: Saurav Bellam
papers.evidence: 小型编码智能体如何使用代码图与嵌入进行仓库定位的实证研究
papers.tldr: 论文检验“代码图与嵌入工具能补足仓库结构”的前提，在SWE-bench Verified上按代码图跳数分层，用10个小开源模型做工具消融（约7.9万回合）。结构化工具把grep基线准确率最高翻倍，增益在1.7–4B达17–21点、32B降至4–5点，且每多一跳定位胜率乘0.50–0.67。线性探针显示小模型仅有单跳、偏词法的仓库表征，作者开源智能体、探针与日志。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are given embedding search and code-graph tools on the premise that a repository's structure is something the model lacks and the tool supplies. We test that premise on SWE-bench Verified with small open-weight models, stratifying tasks by a deterministic hop depth (the shortest code-graph path from code the issue mentions to code the gold patch changes) that a companion paper defines and validates. First, we ablate a localization agent's tool set (grep only; +embedding search; +graph tools; all) on a depth-balanced 160-task split and on all 500 tasks for ten models (six Qwen3 sizes from 0.6B to 32B with five decodings each, an FP8 control, three Gemma 4 sizes; 79k episodes). Structured tools double grep-only accuracy for Qwen3-8B and Gemma 4 E4B; their gain peaks at 17-21 points at 1.7-4B and falls to 4-5 points at 32B (odds ratio 0.77-0.82 per doubling of parameters). From 8B up, about half of that gain is the form of the submission rather than finding the target; the fall from 14B to 32B is a fall in tool uptake at equal grep-only accuracy; and the same 4B size gains or does not gain from a tool depending on the checkpoint. Each extra hop multiplies the odds of correct localization by 0.50-0.67 at every size, and no tool set flattens that gradient: traces show the graph tools' gain is name lookup at hop 0 and one expansion at hop 1, and agents chain expansions in only 12-14% of episodes. A fixed repair model resolves 6-13 of 160 tasks from these localizations (oracle 26). Second, linear probes find direct call edges decodable under a within-anchor, degree-stratified protocol (AUC 0.74; 0.61-0.66 inside agent conversations), but below a lexical baseline (0.99), with two-hop edges at 0.57. Small agents carry a one-hop, largely lexical picture of their repository, in weights and in use. We release the agent, probes, logs and traces.

papers.title_en: MulFCoder: Framework-conditioned Multi-agent for MLLM-based Multi-framework Front-end Code Generation
papers.authors: Jie Wu, Haoran Ma, Shisong Tang, Yulin Xu, Xiaoyu Kang, Jiechao Gao
papers.evidence: 多智能体前端代码生成框架
papers.tldr: 从UI截图生成可运行前端代码已有进展，但现有MLLM方法多聚焦HTML/CSS，React、Vue、Angular等多框架生成仍待探索，简单改提示会放大框架差异与特定错误。MulFCoder将框架约束显式编码进可判定规则空间，用Grounder、Planner、Writer、Judger四智能体协同完成元素解析、布局规划、受限写入与约束校验修复。实验显示其显著提升编译成功率并减少框架特定错误，Angular上收益尤其明显。
papers.abstract_en: Generating runnable front-end code from UI screenshots is a long-standing goal in automated software engineering. Existing MLLM-based methods predominantly focused on HTML/CSS, leaving multi-framework generation for React/Vue/Angular underexplored. Naively modifying prompts leads to substantial performance gaps across multi-framework and highly framework-specific error modes. To address this, we propose MulFCoder, a framework-conditioned multi-agent method that explicitly encodes framework constraints to bring multi-framework differences into a decidable rule space. MulFCoder orchestrates four agents: Grounder constructs an ElementTable, ContentTable, and macro-layout regions from detected UI elements; Planner builds a DOM-like hierarchical layout tree, produces a task schedule, and derives a framework-specific file Contract; Writer generates structured file writes or patches within a restricted edit window; Judger enforces lightweight, framework-conditioned constraints to accept or reject updates and trigger bounded repairs, preventing drift and deadlocks without expensive builds. Experiments demonstrate that MulFCoder substantially improves compilation success rate and reduces framework-specific errors, with particularly pronounced gains on Angular.

papers.title_en: Rethinking Verification in Agent Harnesses
papers.authors: Zhengxin Zhang, Erkang Zhu, Yin Lin, Claire Cardie, Bolin Ding, Jingren Zhou
papers.evidence: 在SWE-bench与Terminal-Bench上评估智能体框架的验证设计
papers.tldr: Agent harness 需通过验证提升输出质量，但何时介入、由谁检查、如何修订缺乏设计指导。论文将验证视为测试时扩展轴，构建覆盖初始指令、轮中提醒、完成门控与独立评审的四层框架，并在 TB、SWE 与 VisualBench 上比较17种设计。结果显示独立评审在准确率与成本间权衡最佳，TB 提升5.9-9.5个百分点、SWE 提升3.9-6.6个百分点，VisualBench 净偏好领先基线13.2-23.8点。研究为 harness 验证设计提供实证依据。
papers.abstract_en: Agent harnesses enable large language models to act through tools, observe the results, and iteratively work toward a task goal. Verification checks and revises agents' work to improve output quality. Yet there is limited guidance on how harnesses should organize this effort. We study verification as an axis of test-time scaling by examining when to intervene, who checks the work, and how checking leads to revision. Our framework spans four layers of the agent lifecycle: initial instructions, mid-turn reminders, completion gates, and independent review. We compare 17 designs across seven frontier coding models on Terminal-Bench (TB) and SWE-bench Verified (SWE), and introduce VisualBench for expert evaluation of visual and interactive artifacts. Initial instructions and execution-time reminders yield modest, model-dependent average gains on the coding benchmarks, without substantially increasing average output token use. Completion gates can yield larger gains but may substantially increase cost. Independent review by a critic offers a more favorable accuracy-cost tradeoff, improving average accuracy by 5.9-9.5 percentage points on TB and 3.9-6.6 on SWE at 1.13-1.25 and 1.00-1.04 times baseline cost, respectively. On VisualBench, independent review achieves net preferences of 13.2-23.8 points over the baseline across its four designs, exceeding the evaluated L0-L2 designs. Additional review rounds or independent critics further improve average TB accuracy by up to 3.5 percentage points. Together, these results provide empirical guidance for verification design in agent harnesses and support independent review as a practical axis of test-time scaling.

papers.title_en: Rivet: Utility-Preserving Context Control for Repository-Level Coding Agents
papers.authors: Ruwei Pan, Linhao Wu, Yakun Zhang, Zixiong Yang, Lu Zhang, Hongyu Zhang
papers.evidence: 仓库级编码智能体的上下文选择
papers.tldr: 仓库级代码生成受上下文预算限制，现有检索、压缩与结构感知方法按任务相似度、上下文长度或结构邻近选上下文，难以保证选中的内容真的包含实现所依赖的仓库证据，造成“上下文效用稀释”。Rivet 先用信号接地融合词法、语义与结构信号定位任务相关代码锚点，再用效用链接沿依赖、调用与配置关系扩展证据，最后由预算整形按优先级打包，预算紧张时先把片段降为签名或摘要再丢弃。在 DevEval 与 RepoExec 上，4 个骨干模型、4K 与 8K 两种预算共 16 个设置全部取得最高 Pass@1，平均超最强基线 3.73–5.15 个百分点。
papers.abstract_en: Repository-level code generation asks an agent to implement a task requirement inside an existing repository. To produce code that works in the repository, the agent needs repository evidence, such as target locations, helper definitions, caller usages, and configuration constraints, which determine how the code should be located, integrated, and executed. Because the context budget cannot hold the entire repository, existing retrieval, compression, and structure-aware methods select context by task similarity, context length, or structural proximity, but these criteria do not directly measure whether the selected context contains this evidence. As a result, the selected context can appear relevant to the task yet miss the evidence that the implementation depends on. We call this failure mode context utility dilution. In this paper, we propose Rivet, a context control framework that preserves repository evidence for coding agents under a fixed context budget. Rivet, first uses Signal Grounding to select task-related code anchors by fusing lexical, semantic, and structural signals. Utility Linking then expands these anchors through dependency, usage, and configuration relations to collect repository evidence. Finally, Budget Shaping packs the evidence by priority and, when the budget is tight, reduces snippets to signatures or summaries before dropping them. We evaluate Rivet, on two executable repository-level benchmarks, DevEval and RepoExec, with four backbone models, two context budgets (4K and 8K tokens), and eight baselines. Rivet, achieves the highest Pass@1 in all 16 settings and improves over the strongest baseline by 3.73--5.15 percentage points on average. Moreover, GPT-5-mini with Rivet, outperforms GPT-5 without Rivet,on both benchmarks while reducing inference cost by 73.3%--84.5%.

papers.title_en: Testing with Coding Agents: A Large-Scale Comparison of Agent-Supported and Human-Authored Pull Requests
papers.authors: Roberto Milanese, Francesco Salzano, Hovhannes Muradyan, Jingjing Wu, Remo Pareschi, Fausto Fasano, Mattia Fazzini
papers.evidence: 大规模比较智能体支持与人类编写的测试拉取请求
papers.tldr: 编码智能体越来越多通过 pull request 提交测试代码，这种分工如何影响长期可维护性仍不清楚。研究分析了 391 个 Java 仓库中 114,134 个已合并 PR，用 PR 级与提交级信号识别五种编码智能体，并在同一仓库内用混合效应模型控制变更规模后进行比较。结果表明，智能体支持的 PR 更常新增测试、更少修改或删除测试，但两者在测试结构、测试异味与覆盖率上差异有限。研究强调，跨项目汇总比较会掩盖甚至反转仓库内的真实差异。
papers.abstract_en: Context. Coding agents increasingly contribute tests through pull requests that developers then maintain, so how testing work is divided affects long-term maintainability.   Objective. We compare pull requests in which developers and coding agents collaborate (agent-supported) with pull requests without detectable agent involvement (human-authored) along five dimensions: the frequency and extent of test changes, their type and context, test structure, test smells, and code coverage.   Method. We analyze 114,134 pull requests merged between January 2025 and April 2026 in 391 Java repositories, identifying five coding agents through pull-request-level and commit-level signals. Since agent adoption varies across projects, we compare the two groups within repositories with mixed-effects models that control for change size.   Results. Pooled across repositories, both groups change test code almost equally often; within repositories, the odds that an agent-supported pull request does so are 1.65 times higher. Agent-supported pull requests add tests more often (odds ratios 1.50-1.58) and modify (0.70-0.76) and delete (0.51-0.77) them less often. We detect no difference in most structural characteristics of the tests they add, which more often have an oracle, nor, in the 95 repositories we could build, in the coverage of their production changes; in test-only pull requests, however, their tests cover less of the code they exercise. Differences in test smells are borderline and not reproduced for individual test methods.   Conclusions. Agent participation is associated with a different mix of testing work, which pooled comparisons across projects can hide or reverse; its relationship with test quality remains uncertain.

papers.title_en: FeatureLoop: Benchmarking Coding Agents under Evolving Requirements
papers.authors: Jia Feng, Alyssa Wu, Cuiyun Gao, Yunlong Wang, Songyuanyi Lu, Zhichao Hu
papers.evidence: 评估编码智能体在需求演化下表现的基准
papers.tldr: 现有编码智能体评测多只看最终正确性，难以衡量需求演进中的反复指导。FeatureLoop 构建 61 个经人工审查的任务，覆盖 34 个仓库、5 种语言和 7 类软件形态，用持久工作区中的演进反馈、完成反馈及累积可执行检查进行评估。12 个前沿模型中最强仅完成 72.1% 的双反馈任务，失败阶段仅 15.4% 能在两次修正内恢复。该基准揭示修复不完整、回归及反馈利用差异，指向低干预可靠开发的障碍。
papers.abstract_en: Software development with coding agents often begins with a rough request that users refine after trying the implementation. Final correctness alone does not capture the repeated guidance this process requires. We introduce FeatureLoop, a benchmark of 61 human-reviewed tasks from 34 repositories across five primary programming languages and seven software forms. Each task follows one development goal in a persistent workspace through evolution feedback, which adds or clarifies requirements, and completion feedback, which reports failures of stated requirements. Cumulative executable checks track new behavior, repair, and preservation of earlier functionality. We evaluate 12 frontier models and find that the strongest completes 72.1% of tasks with both feedback types. Across models, however, only 15.4% of observed failed stages recover within two corrective revisions. Further analysis reveals incomplete repairs, regressions, and model-specific differences in feedback use and token efficiency, identifying obstacles to reliable, low-intervention development.

papers.title_en: CIVER: Causal Intervention Verification for Reliable Code Review
papers.authors: Xinyuan Song, Hasibul Haque, Jay Somasundaram, Ryan Turner, Bowen Zhu, Liang Zhao
papers.evidence: 基于因果干预验证的LLM代码评审缺陷识别
papers.tldr: 随着LLM编码代理大量生成代码贡献，LLM代码评审代理也日益普及，但其评审冗长、误报多、缺乏证据，容易误导开发者与下游代理。CIVER提出基于因果干预的框架，融合评审、干预扰动与验证三个模块，通过专家迭代联合优化，识别真正缺陷并区分误报。在SWE-Review-Bench上，CIVER通过定向修复正确识别77%的真实缺陷，跨项目与下游修复实验显示其可跨仓库泛化并提升编码代理任务成功率，为可靠自动化代码评审提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Code review is essential for maintaining software repositories by identifying defects, improving code quality, and supporting reliable software evolution. With the growing adoption of LLM-based coding agents, an increasing number of code contributions and repository changes are generated by these agents. Consequently, LLM-based code review agents are becoming increasingly prevalent to evaluate these contributions and maintain software quality. However, LLM reviewers often generate lengthy reviews containing numerous potential issues, many of which are false positives or lack sufficient evidence. These unreliable reviews can mislead developers and downstream coding agents, motivating the need to distinguish actionable findings from unsupported claims. We propose CIVER, a causal intervention-based framework that identifies the core issues underlying code-review findings and distinguishes genuine defects from false positives. CIVER integrates three modules: a review module assesses findings, an intervention module generates repair-oriented perturbations, and a verifier module scores review reliability. Through joint optimization via expert iteration, the three modules identify genuine defects by responding to targeted repairs while remaining stable under unrelated changes. Extensive experiments on SWE-Review-Bench demonstrate that CIVER correctly identifies 77% of genuine defects through targeted repairs. Cross-project and downstream repair evaluations further demonstrate that CIVER generalizes across repositories and improves coding agents' task success rates, highlighting its effectiveness for reliable automated code review.

papers.title_en: Do Coding Agents Still Need a Debugger? Frontier-Model-Based Fault Localization at the Accuracy Ceiling
papers.authors: Christoph Daxerer, Johann Glock, Christian Macho, Rudolf Ramler, Martin Pinzger, Josef Pichler
papers.evidence: 编程智能体在有无调试器辅助下的缺陷定位
papers.tldr: 论文评估编码智能体在原始和变换程序上的故障定位，以及调试器辅助的收益与成本。作者向144个LeetCodeDataset解法注入610个单行故障并做五种保持行为变换，比较Sol 6.1、Luna 6和Qwen 3.8。无工具定位率已达96.7%至99.9%；鼓励调试器可清除Luna 6和Qwen 3.8多数残余错误，但token消耗增至14.7至27倍。结论：短小精确程序上仅靠源码已近上限，调试器主要清除残余错误。
papers.abstract_en: Background: To localize a fault, a coding agent can reason from source code alone or use debugger assistance by running the program and stepping through it in an interactive debugger. While earlier agents struggled with static execution tracing and debugger operation, frontier LLMs have improved at both. Objective: We evaluate how accurately coding agents localize faults without tools across original and transformed programs, how much debugger assistance improves accuracy and at what cost, and how agents use it when optional. Methods: We seed 610 single-line faults into 144 LeetCodeDataset solutions and rewrite each faulty program with five recipes of behavior-preserving transformations. Agents based on Sol 6.1, Luna 6, and Qwen 3.8 localize each fault with no, optional, or encouraged debugger assistance. Results: Without tools, the agents localized 98.2 to 99.9% of faults in original and 96.7 to 99.9% in transformed programs, losing accuracy mainly where recipes restructured loops and conditions. Encouraged assistance removed 63% and 61% of Luna 6's and Qwen 3.8's remaining transformed errors (+2.1 and +1.3 percentage points) at 14.7 to 27.0 times the token use, while Sol 6.1 stayed at 99.9%. With optional assistance, Luna 6 and Qwen 3.8 still gained +1.5 and +1.3 points, though the agents used the interactive debugger in only 0.2 to 6.2% of runs. Conclusions: On short, precisely specified programs, current coding agents localize nearly all faults from source code alone, and debugger assistance removes most errors that remain. Given the choice, agents executed the program far more often than they stepped through it, yet kept most of the benefit.

papers.title_en: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Behaviorally Adequate Test Generation from Software Requirements
papers.authors: Binhang Qi, Yiming Liu, Yun Lin, Yangjie Zhou, Hailong Sun, Jin Song Dong
papers.evidence: 评测LLM智能体的自动化测试生成
papers.tldr: 大模型智能体把自然语言需求编译成代码时，需生成测试作为验证约束，但当行为实现被隐藏时，它能否写出有效测试仍不清楚。作者构建 Req2Test-Bench，从8个开源项目的BDD产物中回收5086个可执行实例，覆盖5种编程语言与4个BDD框架，要求智能体依据Gherkin需求生成完整测试实现，以kill-completeness衡量行为充分性。8种配置评测中最佳者测试通过率82.8%，行为充分仅33.8%。该工作揭示需求欠规范造成的信息缺口，并指出需求驱动测试骨架是改进方向。
papers.abstract_en: As large language model agents increasingly compile natural-language requirements into repository-level code, requirement-to-test generation grows in importance to provide validation constraints (or harness) to guide code generation. Yet it remains unclear whether current agents can generate tests that validate the required behavior when the implementation of that behavior is withheld. Existing test-generation benchmarks mostly focus on white-box testing, whereas the requirement--test-related study usually requires evaluation on semantic alignment between the given documents and the generated tests.   We introduce Req2Test-Bench, a benchmark containing 5,086 execution-validated instances recovered from developer-authored behavior-driven development (BDD) artifacts in 8 open-source projects, spanning 5 programming languages and 4 BDD frameworks. Each instance pairs a natural-language requirement in Gherkin with its developer-written Test Implementation. Given the requirement, target interfaces of the required behavior, an agent must generate a complete, potentially multi-file Test Implementation. Evaluation of 8 agent--model--reasoning configurations reveals a substantial gap between execution success and behavioral adequacy, which is measured strictly as kill-completeness: a kill-complete test kills every mutant that the ground-truth test kills. The best-performing configuration, Codex with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, produces passing tests for 82.8% of instances, yet only 33.8% are behaviorally adequate. We find that (1) scaling up agents yields sharply diminishing returns in behavioral adequacy relative to generation cost; (2) under-specified requirements cause the information gap, including ambiguous setup and implicit expected outcomes; and (3) requirement-grounded harnesses that steer agent non-determinism offer a promising direction for improvement.

papers.title_en: InfraDev: Can Coding Agents Develop AI Infrastructure, and How Can We Tell?
papers.authors: Yangshen Deng, Jiaqi Ruan, Yeqi Huang, Nick Lau, Guangming Sheng, Luo Mai
papers.evidence: 面向编码智能体开发多文件AI基础设施改动的基准
papers.tldr: 现有编码智能体基准多局限于单内核或单GPU任务，且测试与提示会同时误判正确与错误补丁，难以衡量真实AI基础设施开发能力。InfraDev从Megatron-LM、vLLM和verl的真实PR构建36个跨文件、多GPU任务，覆盖训练、推理与强化学习基础设施，并联合合成隐藏探针与接口提示进行评测。六款前沿模型最高仅解决38.9%，探针还拒绝32%通过全部官方测试的提交，原始PR描述作提示时无一模型解决任务；将失败分析转为智能体技能后，Megatron-LM任务解决率提升10.5%。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are beginning to develop the production-grade AI infrastructure that trains and serves large models, yet existing benchmarks cover only single kernels or single-GPU tasks, and grade with tests and prompts that misjudge both correct and incorrect patches. We introduce InfraDev, a benchmark of 36 tasks built from real-world pull requests to Megatron-LM, vLLM, and verl, covering infrastructure development for training, inference, and reinforcement learning. Each task asks an agent to reimplement a real change that spans many files and must run correctly across many GPUs. To grade such changes, we jointly synthesize hidden probes, which enforce the requirements the original tests leave unchecked, and a prompt that states every interface the probes call without revealing the solution. We also design a shared execution environment that reuses dependencies and artifacts across tasks, cutting storage by 52-57% and build time by 13-14% on Megatron-LM and vLLM. Across six frontier models, the best resolves only 38.9% of the tasks; the probes reject 32% of the submissions that pass every official test, and with the original pull request descriptions as prompts, no model resolves a single task. Failure analysis shows that structural and state errors dominate and that agents' own tests rarely check memory, time, or traffic. Turning these findings into an agent skill raises the resolved rate of a frontier model on the Megatron-LM tasks by 10.5%.

papers.title_en: MemDev-Bench: Does Memory Help Code Agents?Benchmarking Memory Systems over Real Repository Histories
papers.authors: Guorui Chen, Tao Liu, Zhenzhen Huang, Yidan Zhang, Liyu Jiang, Shuoyuan Wang, Hanchen Sun, Xu He, Dong Li, Yihan Hu, Jianye Hao, Lei Feng
papers.evidence: 在真实仓库历史上评测代码智能体的记忆系统
papers.tldr: 代码智能体在持续演化的真实仓库上工作，记忆系统能否复用经验仍缺乏可靠评测。MemDev-Bench为每个任务配对同仓库、带相关性标注的历史任务，并用自动化流水线构建4,869个可执行可验证历史任务、覆盖555个基础任务。系统评测发现记忆主要提升细粒度定位与编辑及功能正确性，但也会因不重新评估适用性导致失败，且原始历史轨迹比压缩记忆更省步骤。
papers.abstract_en: Code agents increasingly work on evolving real repositories, and memory systems aim to help them reuse earlier experience. However, such experience is diverse and evolving, so it remains unclear how memory systems organize it and thereby affect code agents. Existing benchmarks cannot answer this reliably because they lack either temporally valid histories or control over prior-task relevance. In this paper, we present MemDev-Bench to evaluate how memory systems affect code agents over diverse repository histories. It pairs each task with relevance-annotated earlier tasks from the same repository to build histories with controlled relevance. We also build an automated pipeline that reliably makes these earlier tasks executable and verifiable, producing 4,869 historical tasks for 555 base tasks. Based on MemDev-Bench, our systematic evaluation of memory systems across diverse development scenarios yields three main findings. (1) Memory mainly improves fine-grained localization and editing, increasing functional correctness. (2) Memory also causes failures on otherwise solvable tasks even with related history, and unrelated history tends to increase such failures. These failures mainly stem from agents reusing memory without reassessing its applicability. (3) Compared with using memory systems, directly providing agents with raw historical trajectories substantially reduces their steps. Further analysis suggests that agents save these steps by reusing process information that compressed memories tend to omit. These results suggest that future memory systems should preserve process information and reassess memory applicability against current task context.

papers.title_en: From Code Generator to Engineering Companion: A Plant-aware Agent for PLC Programming
papers.authors: Joschka Kersting, Gesa Benndorf
papers.evidence: 面向PLC编程的植物感知对话式智能体，扩展检索增强大模型代码生成
papers.tldr: PLC编程仍依赖人工在IDE、文档和项目文件间切换。现有检索增强LLM虽能生成高编译率Structured Text，却是一次性流水线，缺乏对具体工厂的持续知识。本文提出面向工厂的对话式副驾驶，引入工厂上下文摄取、聊天优先的解释调试交互，以及从聊天到部署的分级工具权限。系统面向真实工厂基础设施，并让工程师掌控每个产生实际影响的步骤。
papers.abstract_en: Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) coding remains a manual, IDE-centric task that demands constant context switching between documentation, project files, and code editors. Recent work has demonstrated that retrieval-augmented large language models can generate vendor-compliant Structured Text at high compilation rates, yet these systems treat code generation as a one-shot pipeline: the engineer submits a query and receives code, with no persistent knowledge of the specific plant. We present a plant-aware conversational copilot that extends this paradigm in three directions: plant-specific context ingestion, a chat-first interaction model for explanation and debugging, and a graduated tool-access ladder from chat to deployment. The system is designed for real plant infrastructure and keeps the engineer in control of each step that produces real-world effects.

papers.title_en: Benchmarking Coding Agents for System-Level Performance Optimization
papers.authors: Yanze Zhang, Maggie Yongqi Guan, Shudong Liu, Qi Hao, Kanye Ye Wang, Meng Qu, Xiaobo Zhou
papers.evidence: 评估编码智能体在微服务系统级性能优化能力的基准
papers.tldr: 现有编码智能体基准多停留在函数或仓库级，难以评估微服务等分布式系统的端到端性能优化能力。为此，作者提出 MicroPerf-Bench，向真实开源系统注入可复现的性能反模式，构建含65个实例、7个系统、9类反模式的基准。在1755次运行中，最佳配置仅恢复42.0%的性能退化，主要失败是功能正确但未改善端到端性能。该工作揭示了系统级瓶颈定位是当前智能体的关键挑战。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are becoming an increasingly important paradigm for automating software engineering tasks. However, existing coding benchmarks primarily evaluate agents at the function or repository level, leaving their capabilities in more complex distributed software systems largely unexplored. In practice, many modern applications adopt microservice architectures, where end-to-end performance emerges from interactions among multiple independently running services, requiring agents to reason beyond local code changes. To study this capability, we introduce MicroPerf-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on end-to-end performance optimization in microservice systems. Constructing such a benchmark is challenging because reproducible system-level performance fixes are sparse and difficult to attribute. We address this challenge by injecting empirically grounded performance anti-patterns into real-world open-source systems while preserving functionality and ensuring measurable performance degradation. The resulting benchmark contains 65 optimization instances across seven systems and nine anti-patterns, each with an executable environment, functional tests, and mixed-workload evaluation. Across 1,755 runs covering nine agent-model configurations, the best configuration recovers only 42.0% of the injected performance degradation. The dominant failure is not invalid code, but functionally correct and constraint-compliant changes that fail to improve end-to-end performance, highlighting system-level bottleneck localization as a key challenge for current coding agents. The source code and data are available at https://github.com/zyzcjnb/microperf.

papers.title_en: Metamodel-Guided LLM Decoding for Consistent DSL Generation
papers.authors: Boqi Chen, Aren A. Babikian, José Antonio Hernández López
papers.evidence: 面向大模型生成DSL软件制品的元模型引导约束解码
papers.tldr: LLM 生成 DSL 制品时需同时满足具体语法、元模型抽象语法与良构约束，现有约束解码多只保证语法或少量语义约束。MeMoDecode 在每个元模型概念生成后增量映射为部分模型，并验证其能否补全为一致实例，配合从最近可补全快照重试的机制。在四个 DSL 和 0.6B–70B 的六个开源 LLM 上，一致性较无约束解码平均提升 23%、较语法约束解码提升 8%，并提升基准表现且运行开销适中。该工作表明元模型引导解码可跨 DSL 与模型规模有效保障生成一致性。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate software engineering artifacts written in domain-specific languages (DSLs). Correct DSL instances usually must comply with not only the concrete syntax but also the abstract syntax defined by a metamodel augmented with semantic well-formedness constraints. Existing constrained decoding approaches typically guarantee compliance only with concrete syntax or with a limited set of semantic constraints expressed over the generated text, making metamodel-level constraint consistency difficult to enforce during generation. We present MeMoDecode: a decoding framework that enforces a DSL's concrete syntax, abstract syntax, and well-formedness constraints jointly. Specifically, whenever the LLM generates a complete metamodel concept, MeMoDecode incrementally maps the current output to a partial model and verifies whether it can still be completed into a consistent instance. We combine MeMoDecode with a simple retry mechanism that resumes decoding from the most recent completable snapshot whenever an inconsistency is detected. Under a sound backend verifier, MeMoDecode never performs worse than grammar-constrained decoding on alignment metrics satisfying natural assumptions. Across four DSLs and six open-weight LLMs ranging from 0.6B to 70B parameters, MeMoDecode achieves the highest consistency, improving consistency by 23% on average over unconstrained decoding and by 8% on average over grammar-constrained decoding. It also improves benchmark performance while incurring only modest runtime overhead. These results show that metamodel-guided decoding is an effective approach for enforcing DSL consistency during decoding across diverse DSLs and LLM scales.

papers.title_en: AssureCode: Structured Justification for Trustworthy Agentic Coding
papers.authors: Logan Murphy, Wilson Sy, Rhys Balevicius, Kelsie Fung, Karenna Kung, Aren A. Babikian, Marsha Chechik
papers.evidence: 面向可信智能体编码与生成代码验证的结构化论证依据
papers.tldr: AI辅助编程可快速生成大量代码，但生成物是否符合开发者意图并经过有效验证仍是难题。AssureCode 借鉴安全关键系统的保障工程，提出结构化论证方法，用可验证的论证语言显式关联自然语言提示、形式化规约、开发者意图假设与程序分析证据。该方法将论证构建嵌入智能体代码生成流程，并提供工具支持。实证分析初步考察其对AI生成代码正确性保障的作用，为可信智能体编程提供可审计的论证路径。
papers.abstract_en: The use of AI-based tools in software development is rapidly changing how software is produced, enabling large volumes of code to be generated with limited human implementation effort. However, this raises fundamental challenges for ensuring that generated artifacts are aligned with developer intent and have been appropriately validated. In this work, we propose the use of structured argumentation in driving AI-assisted software development. Inspired by techniques from assurance engineering for safety-critical systems, we define a language of justification rationales that explicitly relate informal natural language prompts, formal specifications, assumptions about developer intentions, and program analysis evidence in a structured and verifiable format. We then describe AssureCode, a tool-supported methodology for creating such rationales as part of agentic code generation. We provide an empirical analysis of our implementation where we investigate its capacity to contribute towards justified assurance of correctness for AI-generated code.

papers.title_en: Developers as Managers of AI Agents: A Workplace Shadowing Study
papers.authors: Yi-Hung Chou, June Hyung Kim, Vasisht Kartik, Victoria Jackson, Tobias Schimmer, Thomas Zimmermann, James A. Jones
papers.evidence: 对开发者指挥协调自主AI编码智能体的工作场所跟踪研究
papers.tldr: AI编码代理日趋自主，开发者需持续指挥、协调与核查其工作，但日常专业实践尚不清楚。研究通过影子观察11名职业开发者约15小时、分析255条提示并访谈4.6小时，编码活动与任务切换。结果显示开发者平均33.4%时间用于构思提示或核查响应，任务切换每小时0—101.6次，并归纳出监督者、委派者、学习者三种模式。贡献在于揭示提示还承担理解、需求澄清、代理配置与协调功能，为验证、协作与学习工具设计提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: As AI coding agents become more autonomous, developers increasingly direct, coordinate, and check their work. Yet little is known about these practices in everyday professional development. We shadowed 11 professional developers across approximately 15 hours of work, coded their activities and task transitions, analyzed 255 submitted prompts, and conducted 4.6 hours of follow-up interviews.   Developers spent an average of 33.4% of observed time formulating prompts or checking AI responses, with task-switching rates ranging from 0 to 101.6 switches per hour. Beyond producing artifacts, prompts supported understanding, requirements clarification, agent configuration, and coordination. We identified three recurring patterns: \textit{Supervisor}, involving direct artifact inspection; \textit{Delegator}, involving dialogue-based coordination and delegated implementation and checking; and \textit{Learner}, involving agents primarily to build understanding. Developers sought technical information from agents and organizational context, authority, and alignment from colleagues. Our findings suggest future studies of how developers manage attention across concurrent agent tasks and tools that support verification, coordination, and learning.

papers.title_en: AT-AT: Automatic Tool Optimization from Agent Traces
papers.authors: Maya Ravichandran, Pragya Tripathi, Dharamendra Kumar, Adith Swaminathan, Nathan Kallus
papers.evidence: 编码智能体利用轨迹优化工具
papers.tldr: 现有LLM智能体优化多聚焦智能体本身，却忽视共享工具的描述与实现同样影响调用和反馈。AT-AT读取历史轨迹与评估结果，在不改动智能体的情况下离线自动编辑工具描述，并在允许时修改实现。在τ²-bench-verified航空与电信领域，它以更低成本取得最高完成率，电信提升显著，并提升TerminalBench-2与TBLite留出表现；企业三个MCP服务器成本或错误率均下降。该工作把执行轨迹转化为共享工具环境更新，为环境侧持续学习提供路径。
papers.abstract_en: Efforts to improve LLM-based agents typically focus on modifying the agent itself, yet success also depends on the environment in which an agent acts. Tools mediate this interaction: a tool's description shapes how an agent calls it, and its implementation determines the results and errors the agent receives afterwards. Many tools, such as APIs and MCP servers, are shared by many agents and maintained by providers who cannot change those agents. We introduce AT-AT (Automatic Tool Optimization from Agent Traces), an agentic tool optimizer that improves a shared toolset offline from historical agent executions while holding the agents fixed. A lightweight coding agent reads agent trajectories and their evaluation results, and selectively edits tool descriptions and, when permitted, implementations. On $τ^2$-bench-verified, AT-AT achieves the highest task completion rates in the Airline and Telecom domains at lower cost than strong prompt- and tool-optimizer baselines, and its Telecom gain is statistically significant under paired permutation tests. Optimizing the tools within a coding agent harness also improves held-out performance on TerminalBench-2 and TBLite. When applied to three production MCP servers at a large enterprise, AT-AT lowered cost or tool error rates on every server and increased held-out task passes on one. By turning accumulated execution traces into updates to shared tool environments, AT-AT provides a path toward continual improvement of agent systems through environment-side learning.

papers.title_en: BenchMeUp: Building Software Engineering Benchmarks from Natural-Language Specifications
papers.authors: Islem Bouzenia, Michael Pradel
papers.evidence: 用大模型智能体自动构建软件工程基准
papers.tldr: 软件工程基准手工构建成本高，需寻找合适实例、配置执行环境、确定预期结果并验证正确性。BenchMeUp 从自然语言规格生成搜索规则与构建计划，调用并行 LLM 智能体筛选并构造可执行实例，再在全新环境中验证并封装为统一命令行接口。在程序修复、问题复现、编译器调优和静态分析警告修复四类任务上，目标 200 个实例，实际构建 198 个，196 个成功打包，单实例约 36 分钟、0.79 美元。它证明 LLM 智能体可跨任务自动化基准构建，但执行之外的有效性仍需核查。
papers.abstract_en: Software-engineering research relies on benchmarks that evaluate new techniques on a set of problem instances. Unfortunately, manually constructing benchmarks is labor-intensive, as researchers must find suitable instances, prepare execution environments, establish expected outcomes, and validate correctness.   This paper presents BenchMeUp, an approach for automatically creating software-engineering benchmarks from natural-language specifications. Given a specification defining the desired instances, data sources, and evaluation procedures, BenchMeUp generates search rules and a construction plan, invokes parallel LLM agents that identify candidate instances and construct executable instances, validates the results in fresh execution environments, and packages the instances behind a unified command-line interface. We evaluate the approach on four tasks: program repair, issue reproduction, compiler autotuning, and fixing static-analysis warnings. Targeting 50 instances per task (200 in total), BenchMeUp constructs 198 instances, of which 196 (99\%) are successfully packaged. Search and construction take 36 minutes and \$0.79 per instance, on average. Evaluating eight existing techniques on the generated benchmarks, we find that 189 of 196 packaged instances (96\%) support end-to-end evaluation, allowing users to study the effectiveness of the techniques. Checking every constructed instance against its source, the specification, and its expected outcome, we find that 180 of 198 (91\%) meet all criteria, compared with 10 of 200 instances delivered by Codex (general-purpose coding agent).   Overall, we show that LLM-based agents can automate benchmark construction across diverse software-engineering tasks and produce executable instances that existing techniques can use, while validity beyond execution still needs to be checked.

papers.title_en: Object-Oriented Harness: Evolving Agent Harnesses through Object-Oriented Design
papers.authors: Gaotang Li, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra, Yifei Ming, Yanfei Chen, Zhongying CuiZhu, Lesly Miculicich, Long T. Le, Rui Meng, Chun-Liang Li, Hanghang Tong, Chen-Yu Lee, Tomas Pfister
papers.evidence: 以面向对象设计演化智能体框架层级并为异构任务路由
papers.tldr: 单一全局 harness 难以适应需要不同执行策略的异构任务。本文提出面向对象式 harness 优化框架 OO-Harness，通过进化代理利用执行记录构建可继承的专用 harness 类层级，并在测试时用 harness 路由器按任务选择具体 harness。在三个长程基准上性能最优，较基线最高提升 15%。该工作把面向对象设计引入 agent harness 的自动化优化，为多策略任务提供模块化可复用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Agent harnesses are executable code that specifies the prompts, tools, and control flow around a language model. A single global harness can struggle with heterogeneous tasks that require different execution strategies. In this work, we introduce Object-Oriented Harness (OO-Harness), a harness optimization framework that evolves a hierarchy of executable harness classes using object-oriented design. During training, an evolution agent uses execution records to create a family of specialized harnesses, each implemented as a subclass of the base or an existing specialized harness via inheritance. At test time, a harness router uses routing lessons accumulated during training to select a specific harness for each task. Across three long-horizon benchmarks spanning business workflows, workspace tasks, and tool use, OO-Harness achieves the best performance among the compared methods, with an absolute improvement of up to 15% over the base. Extensive ablation studies examine the contributions of its core components.

papers.title_en: ULME: Predictive Coupling for Mutually Reinforcing Embedding and Language Modeling
papers.authors: Yang Liu, Zhiqiang Yuan, Shu-Dong Huang, Jiancheng Lv, Liwei Yang, Qiwei Yan, Kailin Lv, Jinchao Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向大模型检索增强与智能体系统的嵌入与语言建模统一方法
papers.tldr: 现有统一嵌入与生成模型多共享参数却未让两种能力相互塑造。ULME 在因果解码器 LLM 的查询与答案间插入可学习 slots，分别读取语义与推理嵌入，并用对比损失、语言建模损失和停止梯度预测损失联合训练。在 Qwen2.5/Qwen3 的 0.5B–8B 八个规模上，单检查点将 MTEB 提升 3.3–4.1 分，并同时收紧 BRIGHT 与 AdvBench-IR。该工作表明真正统一的嵌入与生成可相互增强而非仅共存。
papers.abstract_en: Text embedding and text generation are two of the most useful capabilities of modern large language models, yet they are typically provided by separate specialized models (an embedder and a generator) trained with incompatible objectives and deployed side by side in retrieval-augmented generation and agent systems. Recent unified embedding-generation models such as GritLM share parameters between the two capabilities, but they either switch attention regimes between modes or optimize embedding and language modeling as parallel objectives that never supervise each other. We argue that these designs are only partially unified: the two capabilities coexist on the same weights, but do not shape each other. We propose ULME, a post-training framework that unifies embedding and language modeling on a causal decoder-only LLM through predictive coupling. ULME inserts a chain of learnable slots between the query and the answer, reads a semantic embedding and a reasoning embedding from two designated slots, and trains three objectives on a shared causal backbone: a contrastive loss anchoring the semantic slot to document representations, a language-modeling loss supervising answer generation, and a stop-gradient predictive loss that aligns the reasoning slot with a pooled summary of the answer, so that generation actively shapes what the embedding encodes. Across two model families (Qwen2.5, Qwen3) and eight scales spanning 0.5B-8B parameters, a single ULME checkpoint improves MTEB by 3.3-4.1 points over the strongest open-source baseline, tightens BRIGHT and AdvBench-IR simultaneously, and remains on par with a generation-only fine-tune on standard accuracy benchmarks (MMLU, GSM8K, MMLU-Pro, HumanEval), demonstrating that genuine unification yields mutually reinforcing rather than merely coexisting capabilities.

papers.title_en: Harnessing Language Models as Optimization Modeling Agents
papers.authors: Yunxiang Luo, Xin Xu, Tianhao Chen, Zhixi Xiong, Peiqi Jiang, Fan Zhang, Wei Shao, Xuejian Gao, Yuwei Fan, Can Yang
papers.evidence: 将优化问题转化为求解器程序的LLM智能体框架
papers.tldr: 大语言模型能把自然语言优化问题转成求解器程序，但可靠生成正确建模与实现仍然困难。作者提出 OPTICYCLE 与 OPTISTATE 两个轻量推理框架，无需额外训练，靠执行反馈迭代修正。在9个基准、2634道题、11个Qwen模型（0.6B-27B）上验证，执行引导修订普遍提升宏平均准确率，最高提升49.46个百分点，且优于六个智能体工作流与四个后训练优化模型。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can translate natural-language optimization problems into solver programs, but reliably producing correct formulations and implementations remains challenging. Existing approaches improve optimization modeling through agentic workflows or task-specific post-training. This raises a practical question: can a lightweight harness using a single model role achieve competitive performance without additional training? We introduce OPTICYCLE and OPTISTATE, two lightweight inference harnesses for optimization modeling, and evaluate them on nine benchmarks comprising 2,634 problems using 11 Qwen variants spanning 0.6B-27B parameters. Our results show that execution-guided revision consistently improves macro accuracy over direct generation for all evaluated models, with gains of up to 49.46 percentage points. Despite their simplicity, both harnesses outperform six adapted agentic workflows in same-model comparisons and four evaluated post-trained optimization models at comparable model sizes, without additional training. Explicit formulation state provides further but model-dependent improvements, suggesting that additional structure is not universally beneficial.
